en.title: Minimum Rounds to Finish All Tasks with a Boosted Main Task
en.description:
In each round, choose one unfinished task to run for x seconds, while every other unfinished task runs for y seconds, where x>y. A task leaves once it reaches its required time. Find the minimum number of rounds.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n x y, and the second line contains n required times. The original only states x>y with no numeric bounds; this site sets 1≤n≤100000, 0≤time≤10^9, 0≤y<x≤10^9. Tasks with time 0 are finished from the start.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; 0; 8. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Binary search the number of rounds t. Each task first gets t*y of baseline service, and the remainder needs ceil((time−t*y)/(x−y)) main-task turns; check whether the total is ≤t.
